name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Drawer (Base UI drawer or vaul). Like Sheet docked to an edge: paper, a 3px ink line on the open side and an offset second frame thrown onto the page as its shadow, in all four directions. The grab handle is a 2px ink bar with square ends, 64px wide; the title is in lettering; the footer sits above a 2px rule. The library keeps its own slide and drag transforms; the wrapper only makes their timing stepped (steps(5)), so swiping still follows the finger, and nothing moves with reduced motion. The veil comes from base. Adds DrawerCard, a static look-alike of an open drawer for previews and frozen states. Buttons inside are the kit Button.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/drawer". It wraps your own components/ui/drawer, so Radix (vaul) and Base UI both work. The side keeps each library's own prop: swipeDirection="down|up|left|right" on Base UI, direction="bottom|top|left|right" on vaul. The grab handle is styled in both: vaul draws it on bottom drawers; on Base UI pass showSwipeHandle to Drawer. DrawerSwipeHandle (Base UI only) is not re-exported. Put the kit Button inside for actions.

meta.tagline: A case that slides up from the edge, with an ink grab bar.
meta.usage:
import { Drawer, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, DrawerTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/drawer"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/manga/button"

<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger>Reading goal</DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Daily reading goal</DrawerTitle>
      <DrawerDescription>How many chapters a day?</DrawerDescription>
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerFooter><Button>Set the goal</Button></DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>

props.name: swipeDirection / direction
props.description: On Drawer: the edge it slides from, with each library's own prop. The 3px line and the offset frame follow it.

props.name: DrawerCard
props.description: Static twin of an open drawer: side, handle, title, description, footer, children. No portal, no veil.
